title: Changelog - April 2016
text:
## Changelog - April 2016
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093651
New Features:
New Design Settings added.
Strict Search Results Locations (New Website Setting)
Two more options for the homepage layout.
Ability to filter leads by sub-level categories
Ability to link custom forms to the lead module
Full flexibility regarding the customization of the "Get matched form"
Dynamic Form for Contact Details, Listing Details and About Tab.
Google Location Map to Pin-Point members on Search Results.
New Website Inquiries Module (Tied with the New Leads Module).
Thank you Message for Contact Us Form, Send Message Form and Write Reviews Form.
Member Search Visibility Options (Membership Levels).
H elp Search Support Topic Feature on your Admin Dashboard.
New Payment Gateway for our Billing Module: Stripe (Highly Recommended.) You can read the complete article about the new Billing Module Here
Basic Lead Module Beta Launch
Membership level upgrade options
Enhancements / Fixes:
Full Optimizations to the code Infrastructure with enhancements in all modules of the system.
More than 50+ bugs fixed ranging from Backend, Admin Panel, Frontend and more.
